text:
alex: noticing weird app-of-apps behavior in prod eu-west-1 — massive sync fanout started ~10:05 and now GPU node eviction churn. any recent changes?

maria: saw alerts too. argocd reported a ton of 429s to kube-apiserver and then started pruning lots of orphaned resources.

sam: is this the same app-of-apps rollout we triggered earlier? i only pushed a small helm tweak.

alex: yeah small values change in billing-services root app. but argocd exploded because of fanout to ~120 leaf apps, some in the gpu-pool namespace. pruning and sync waves overlapped.

neha: logs from argocd: 
```
level=warn msg="apiserver rate limited: 429 Too Many Requests" component=repo-server
level=error msg="prune failed: API error 429" component=application-controller
```

taylor: kube-apiserver metrics showing burst: `apiserver_request_total{code="429"}` spiked. also kube-controller-manager retry backlog increased.

infra-oncall: GPU pool started evicting pods around then because of taint/labels churn — the autoscaler rebalanced nodes mid-sync and GPU workloads couldn’t grab resources.

alex: suggestion: pause prune waves and let syncs settle? or throttle app-of-apps fanout so argocd doesn't call kube-apiserver in parallel.

maria: can we temporarily scale argocd replicas + bump apiserver QPS? quick fix: scale argocd to 4 and add client-burst?

sam: i'm hesitant to change apiserver flags in prod. quicker: tag the big app-of-apps with `argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "20"` and requeue so leaf syncs serialise.

neha: command to list current app syncs: 
```
argocd app list --server argocd.prod.redwood --namespace argocd | grep -E "SYNCING|PRUNING"
```

alex: also see this in cluster events: 
```
kubectl get events -n gpu-pool --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -20
# lots of FailedKillPod / Eviction messages tied to node drain/relabel jobs
```

taylor: longer term: we should add fanout limits in our app-of-apps generator and make prune waves non-overlapping. maybe ensure `sync-wave` default for leaf apps is spaced.

infra-oncall: for immediate mitigation i will: 1) pause the topo app-of-apps sync, 2) scale argocd to 4, 3) mark gpu-pool nodes cordoned until we stabilise. doing step 1 now.

argocd-bot: paused sync for `topology-root` by infra-oncall at 10:15 UTC :pause_button:

maria: after paused, apiserver 429s dropped by ~70% within 3m. evictions slowed. good signal.

sam: i'll roll back my helm tweak for billing-services to reduce immediate fanout.

neha: opened a small RFC to add app-of-apps fanout control and to change default prune concurrency: https://go/redwood/rfc/app-fanout-throttle (WIP)

alex: add checklist: - change generator to set sync-wave spacing - limit argocd application-controller concurrency in helm chart - add k8s admission/owner fixes to reduce orphan pruning

taylor: also add alert for apiserver 429 spike tied to argocd source so oncall get earlier nudge.

infra-oncall: will keep paused for 30m and then unwind with staged waves. will post update when we resume.

maria: thanks — great catch. saved a bunch of GPU hours and churn. :thumbsup:
